js.language.a_while_loop_could_run_forev: A while loop could run forever and freeze the console. Count with  for i in range(n):  (at most 1024 rounds).
js.language.prg32_python_is_a_small_part: PRG32 Python is a small part of Python that can become a cartridge: typed variables, if/elif/else, for ... in range(...), your own functions and the prg32 module.
js.language.a_prg32_python_game_imports_: A PRG32 Python game imports only the prg32 module:  import prg32. Other modules need a computer with Python; a cartridge has none.
js.language.functions_that_run_text_as_c: Functions that run text as code or open files are not part of PRG32 Python: the game is translated into C, never run as Python.
js.language.the_prg32_has_no_console_win: The PRG32 has no console window. Write on the screen with prg32.text(x, y, "TEXT") or prg32.number(value, x, y).
js.language.prg32_numbers_are_whole_numb: PRG32 numbers are whole numbers. Use // to divide (7 // 2 is 3); the remainder is %.
js.language.write_the_multiplication_out: Write the multiplication out (x * x), or use a fixed number.
js.language.prg32_numbers_are_whole_numb: PRG32 numbers are whole numbers. For fractions, scale them: 256 can mean 1.0.
js.language.this_name_is_not_part_of: This name is not part of the prg32 module. Check the spelling; Ctrl+Space lists what prg32 offers.
js.language.write_import_prg32_at_the_to: Write  import prg32  at the top of game.py before using prg32.
js.language.write_the_game_before_checki: Write the game before checking it.
js.language.a_cartridge_source_can_be_at: A cartridge source can be at most 256 KiB, without NUL bytes.
js.language.trigraphs_and_are_an_old_c: Trigraphs (??= and ??/) are an old C feature the kit does not accept.
js.language.a_comment_needs_a_matching_t: A /* comment needs a matching */ to end it.
js.language.a_prg32_cartridge_can_includ: A PRG32 cartridge can include only prg32.h, prg32_audio.h, stdint.h, stddef.h and stdbool.h. Other headers would need a C library or files on the server.
js.language.the_operator_can_build_hidde: The ## operator can build hidden words, so the kit does not accept it.
js.language.inline_assembly_and_pragma_c: Inline assembly and _Pragma could read files on the server while compiling. Write assembly in an Assembly project instead.
js.language.the_console_calls_three_func: The console calls three functions named after your project title: init once, then update and draw for every frame. Each must be written exactly as  void NAME(void) { ... }.
js.language.this_function_exists_only_in: This function exists only inside the PRG32 firmware. A portable cartridge can call only the functions in the PRG32 ABI, so the build would stop with "undefined reference".
js.language.this_name_starts_with_prg32_: This name starts with prg32_ but is not part of the PRG32 API. Check the spelling.
js.language.the_buzzer_is_obsolete_prg32: The buzzer is obsolete: PRG32 games use the eight-voice audio engine (instruments with ADSR envelopes, stereo pan, sound effects and soundtracks made in AudioStudio). The server refuses this name.
js.language.include_incbin_and_pragma_co: include, incbin and _Pragma could read files on the server, so they are not allowed.
js.language.in_assembly_only_define_name: In assembly only  #define NAME value  and #if / #ifdef / #ifndef / #elif / #else / #endif / #undef are allowed as preprocessor lines.
js.language.only_the_directives_the_kit_: Only the directives the kit lists are allowed; others could read files or change how the cartridge is built.
js.language.put_code_in_text_and_data: Put code in .text and data in .rodata, .data or .bss (or sub-sections such as .text.game).
js.language.the_console_calls_three_labe: The console calls three labels named after your project title: init, update and draw. Each needs a label (NAME:) and .globl NAME so the console can find it.
js.language.this_is_not_an_rv32imc_instr: This is not an RV32IMC instruction or pseudo-instruction the assembler knows.
js.language.risc_v_has_32_registers_x0: RISC-V has 32 registers: x0-x31, or by their ABI names zero, ra, sp, gp, tp, t0-t6, s0-s11 (fp = s0) and a0-a7.
js.language.only_the_functions_in_prg32_: Only the functions in prg32.h (portable API) can be used.
js.language.this_function_is_used_before: This function is used before it is declared. Declare or define it above, or check the spelling.
js.language.a_statement_must_end_with_lo: A statement must end with ; (look at the end of the line before, too).
js.language.this_name_is_not_declared_ch: This name is not declared: check the spelling, or declare the variable first.
js.language.the_program_calls_something_: The program calls something that does not exist in a PRG32 cartridge.
js.language.this_name_is_declared_twice_: This name is declared twice with different types.
js.language.the_assembler_does_not_under: The assembler does not understand this instruction or its operands.
js.language.c_source_has_a_comment_that: C source has a comment that never ends
js.language.only_approved_prg32_standard: Only approved PRG32/standard headers and basic conditional or define directives are supported
js.language.the_token_pasting_operator_i: The ## token-pasting operator is not supported
js.language.prg32_python_imports_only_on: PRG32 Python imports only one module: import prg32
js.language.the_prg32_has_no_console_use: The PRG32 has no console: use prg32.text or prg32.number
js.language.write_import_prg32_at_the_to: Write import prg32 at the top first
js.language.kept_across_calls_save_it_be: kept across calls (save it before you change it)
